scope: Standalone generated public Boolean quadratic systems at <=24 variables. No external input, curves, scalars, production solver or rho campaign.
selection: Fix low coordinates 0 through k-1 for k=4,5,6. Annihilate the span of internal quadratic coefficient words with exact GF2 elimination. No selection or tuning from holdout timings.
contract: All original solutions satisfy the projected affine subsystem. Column elimination returns a particular solution plus a complete kernel basis. Enumerate every extension when needed and verify all original equations. Projection-only consistency is never a solution. Current coefficient values and rank are recomputed for every outside assignment. Exceeded caps return UNKNOWN.
accounting: Every arm measures complete cold solve including encoding, allocation, projection, elimination, extension recovery, original-equation checks and destruction, plus external model/status validation. Reference preparation and common fixture generation are outside arm clocks, inside process receipts. No timing subtraction. Diagnostic profiled/rebound wrappers are not new solver policies and are not repeated.
ordering: Four deterministic Fisher-Yates permutations per fixture, each followed by its reverse, using retained SplitMix64 ordering.
boundary: Complete generic-solver comparison only; no hardware-independent operation conversion or cryptanalytic floor is available. Necessary-condition filtering alone is not a completed solve.
final_gate: Every candidate must complete and verify all 216 cells and have paired 95 percent median-ratio lower bound >2.0 versus pointwise fastest retained reference in every n16/n20/n24, family, regression/holdout group (18 groups). Incremental >1.0 is separately reported. No single group or projected dimension implies promotion. Any positive discovery/holdout result requires unchanged-source confirmation on unused holdouts.
